name: Deep Dive
description: Stylized 3D "What happens if...?" explainers in 9:16. Sculpted people in warm sunlit sets, glowing x-ray cutaways, camera journeys through blood vessels, shallow focus, and a camera that never stops moving. The video moves between three worlds: the real world, the x-ray, and inside the body.
style: Real 3D in three.js: warm low sun outside, cyan x-ray glass inside the body, deep red macro shots with bloom. Shallow focus always, camera always moving. No gore — danger shown as x-ray, glow or warning colour.
